review_candidates.title: Auxiliar de soporte de TI
review_candidates.description: Estamos buscando un Asistente de Soporte IT. ¿Te apasiona la tecnología y disfrutas ayudando a las personas a resolver problemas? ¡Esta oportunidad es para ti! Buscamos un Asistente de Soporte IT que se una a nuestro equipo y contribuya a garantizar el correcto funcionamiento de los sistemas y equipos tecnológicos en nuestras tiendas y oficinas. En un entorno dinámico y de constante evolución, tendrás la oportunidad de brindar soporte técnico a los usuarios, resolver incidencias y colaborar en el mantenimiento de los sistemas que hacen posible la operación diaria del negocio. ¿Qué harás? Brindar soporte técnico a los colaboradores de tiendas y oficinas, atendiendo incidencias relacionadas con hardware, software, redes y dispositivos tecnológicos. Instalar, configurar y actualizar sistemas operativos, aplicaciones, equipos y periféricos. Diagnosticar y solucionar problemas técnicos relacionados con equipos de punto de venta (POS), terminales de pago, impresoras, escáneres y sistemas de inventario. Realizar mantenimiento preventivo y correctivo de equipos tecnológicos para garantizar su funcionamiento óptimo. Apoyar a los usuarios en la instalación y configuración de herramientas tecnológicas y aplicaciones de gestión de stock y ventas. Registrar, monitorear y dar seguimiento a las incidencias mediante herramientas de gestión de tickets. Mantener actualizado el inventario de hardware y software. Elaborar y actualizar documentación técnica, manuales y guías de resolución de incidencias. Colaborar con los diferentes equipos de IT para asegurar la continuidad y eficiencia de los sistemas tecnológicos. ¿Qué buscamos? Formación técnica o estudios en curso en Informática, Sistemas, Tecnología o carreras afines. Experiencia previa en soporte técnico, asistencia IT o posiciones similares. Conocimientos básicos de hardware, software, sistemas operativos y redes. Familiaridad con equipos de punto de venta (POS), impresoras, escáneres y periféricos. Habilidades para diagnosticar y resolver incidencias técnicas. Orientación al servicio, capacidad de análisis y atención al detalle. Organización, proactividad y disposición para aprender. Habilidad para comunicarse de manera clara y brindar soporte a usuarios con diferentes niveles de conocimiento tecnológico. ¿Qué te ofrecemos? La oportunidad de formar parte de un equipo dinámico y colaborativo. Un entorno de aprendizaje y desarrollo profesional. La posibilidad de contribuir directamente al funcionamiento y crecimiento de una operación regional. ¡Si te apasiona la tecnología y quieres formar parte de nuestro equipo, queremos conocerte!

review_candidates.title: Assoc Engr-Account Svcs
review_candidates.description: When you join Verizon You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife. What You’ll Be Doing... As an Assoc Engr-Account Svcs, You will be a part of a team that plays a key role in providing managed support services to customers with specialized solutions, contractual obligations & custom processes. You will provide real-time incident management during service-related issues - triage & troubleshoot to identify the root cause, escalate & engage internal/external vendors until the issue is resolved. You will also leverage their technical expertise to consult on improving the clients’ network connectivity and support services. You will assist with Event Support for highly visible clients such as NFL, FIFA, NHL, NASCAR, ect. This will be a 24x7 position that may include holidays, overnight, and weekend shifts to meet our customer needs. Providing direct support for clients’ service management including Incident management, Triage, Trouble Ticket handling, coordinating planned/unplanned scheduled maintenance communications. Providing technical and/or analytical support to solve a wide range of difficult issues or problems using standard or customized protocol analyzers to ensure post-sales lifecycle relationships. Monitoring and recording progress for all activities until the full resolution of the issue(s). Including coordinating best effort resolution with internal organizations, vendors, and clients. Providing problem management support to detect root causes and mitigate against future events in partnership with our vendors. Monitoring the clients’ performance, OnSite LTE equipment (i.e. RAN, core, router, and backhaul) for alarms. When alarms are detected, they are validated and correlated and if actionable, tickets are created and worked. Making recommendations that aid in the successful completion of projects within a product or functional area. Working on multiple projects/activities concurrently: Monitoring project progress, anticipate and reduce risk, and influencing business partners to meet delivery milestones. Developing, maintaining, and improving the service experience for customers, employees, and partners and represents those interests at all times. Generating & formatting custom reporting to monitor defined KPIs (Key Performance Indicators) across several technologies and implements action plans when metrics fall below agreed KPIs. Scheduling and installing relevant software prior to the implementation of such software, verify successful installation prior to completing the maintenance activity. And ensure approved device manufacturer software and firmware are up to date. Where you'll be working... This hybrid role will have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days as set by the manager. To be eligible for this position, you must be located within a 90-minute commute of the BGCO location specified on this job posting. For consideration in the Salt Lake City, UT, and Annapolis Junction, MD, locations, you must be a current WCC employee based in Salt Lake City, UT, or Annapolis Junction, MD. You’ll Need To Have Bachelor’s degree or one or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through work experience and/or military experience. Even better if you have one or more of the following: If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above. Where you’ll be working In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies. Scheduled Weekly Hours 40 Equal Employment Opportunity Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics. Benefits And Compensation Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home & auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances. The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job-related skills and experience. This is an incentive based position with the potential to earn more. For part-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours. The annual salary range for the location(s) listed on this job requisition based on a full-time schedule is: $59,000.00 - $106,000.00.

review_candidates.description: Our Online Banking Support team provides support for our Consumer, Small business Online banking application. We work closely with our business partners, vendors and product team to effectively support the online banking platform. This includes our main platform and other subsidiary applications that support the online banking experience. As an Application Support Specialist , you will provide technical application support and create solutions across a broad range of products. This will include working incident tickets, monitoring systems performance, and assisting with or applying application fixes and upgrades. You will also troubleshoot and triage problems and incidents on production applications. This is a subset of the overall responsibilities which will include multiple initiatives as assigned by IT leadership. This role is hybrid (Mon thru Thu on-site / Fri remote) located in our Kansas City, MO or Dubuque, IA location. How You Will Spend Your Time Serve as a point of contact for incidents to coordinate issue resolution working with applications teams, vendors, business units, and varied departments. Analyze and measure problem and incident data to identify underlying and systemic problems which also includes implementing solutions to resolve current incidents and reduce or eliminate future incidents. Manage post-mortem analysis process for high priority incidents and problems. Document resolutions to allow for reuse processes, trending and categorization of issues. Work closely with business peers, Vendors, application teams and management to develop and implement process improvements that aid in the reduction in problem tickets and increase in system performance. Coordinating with third-party vendors to resolve issues and meet SLAs. Identify and recommend practices that reduce and eliminate problems and outages of managed information systems and applications. Provide assistance to less experienced associates to aid in problem resolution. Share on call with other team members. We are excited to talk if you have At least 5 years of experience in a technical role supporting financial applications, including familiarity with transaction processing and online banking applications. Knowledge and experience troubleshooting production issues that span multiple systems. Knowledge and/or experience with Splunk. Experience supporting Q2 (vendor) applications or similar online banking systems. Ability to field incoming incident tickets to identify and resolve application issues within a high-pressure environment. A proactive focus utilizing the available system monitoring tools. A logical thinking mindset with strong analytical skills and experience performing and coordinating Root Cause Analysis and trend analysis. An inquisitive approach and successfully demonstrated the ability to conduct research independently to find a solution without being prompted. Bonus Points if you have Experience with ServiceNow or a similar ticketing system. Worked in a banking or financial services industry. Experience with Splunk scripting. Experience supporting API integrated systems. Applicants must have legal authority to work in the United States. Work Visa sponsorship is not available for this position. This position was posted on 09/21/2026. The application deadline for this position is 45 days from the posting date unless filled earlier. Compensation Range $81,864 - $120,406 The posted compensation range on this listing represents UMB’s good faith and reasonable estimate based on its budget and what it expects to be the starting pay for this role, but the actual compensation may vary by geographic location, experience level, and other job-related factors. Please see the description of benefits included with this job posting for additional information. UMB offers competitive and varied benefits to eligible associates, such as Paid Time Off; a 401(k) matching program; annual incentive pay; paid holidays; a comprehensive company sponsored benefit plan including medical, dental, vision, and other insurance coverage; health savings, flexible spending, and dependent care accounts; adoption assistance; an employee assistance program; fitness reimbursement; tuition reimbursement; an associate wellbeing program; an associate emergency fund; and various associate banking benefits. Benefit offerings and eligibility requirements vary. Are you ready to be part of something more? You're more than a means to an end—a way to help us meet the bottom line. UMB isn't comprised of workers, but of people who care about their work, one another, and their community. Expect more than the status quo. At UMB, you can expect more heart. You'll be valued for exactly who you are and encouraged to support causes you care about. Expect more trust. We want you to do the right thing, no matter what. And, expect more opportunities. UMBers are known for having multiple careers here and having their voices heard. UMB and its affiliates are committed to inclusion and diversity and provide employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), national origin, age, disability, military service, veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. If you need accommodation for any part of the employment process because of a disability, please send an e-mail to talentacquisition@umb.com to let us know the nature of your request. review_candidates.title: Stock Control & Master Data Officer مراقب مخزون ومسئول البيانات الأساسية
review_candidates.description: Stock Control & Master Data Officerمراقب مخزون ومسئول البيانات الأساسية Location: Cairo, Egypt Employment Type: Full-time – On-site Department: Planning & Warehouses / Supply Chain Company Description Gustave Roussy International – Egypt is the first international branch of France’s leading cancer hospital, located in Cairo. The organization is committed to excellence in cancer prevention, diagnosis, treatment, research, and education, bringing internationally recognized clinical standards and innovative practices to the Egyptian healthcare environment. Team members work within a multidisciplinary and highly regulated hospital environment focused on patient safety, operational excellence, data accuracy, and continuous improvement. Role Purpose The Stock Control & Master Data Officer is a key operational control role responsible for maintaining accurate inventory records, governing item master data, monitoring stock movements, investigating discrepancies, and supporting reliable supply planning across central warehouses and hospital sub-stores. The position acts as a control point between warehouse operations, planning, procurement, clinical departments, finance, and other relevant stakeholders , ensuring that inventory and master data remain accurate, traceable, consistent, and ready for operational and management decision-making. The role combines: Inventory Control + Master Data Governance + Data Quality + Reconciliation + Operational Analysis MEDICAL SUPPLIES , NURSING OR MEDIACAL BACKGROUND IS ESSENTIAL Key ResponsibilitiesInventory Control & Reconciliation Monitor inventory balances, stock movements, receipts, issues, returns, transfers, and adjustments. Perform regular reconciliation between system balances, physical stock, warehouse transactions, and supporting documentation. Investigate inventory variances and perform Root Cause Analysis before recommending corrective actions. Monitor negative stock, unusual movements, duplicated transactions, and other inventory exceptions. Support periodic and cycle counts and ensure that variances are properly investigated, documented, and approved. Monitor inventory activity across central warehouses and relevant hospital sub-stores. Support reconciliation of departmental issues and related operational or financial documentation. Master Data Governance Maintain and review the Item Master across inventory and ERP systems. Validate: Item Codes Arabic / English Descriptions Units of Measure Categories and Classifications Stock / Non-Stock Status Supplier / Brand-related information Pricing information where applicable Item activation and deactivation status Detect and prevent duplicate or incorrectly created item codes. Review similar item names and UOM differences before requesting or approving creation of new master-data records. Support data standardization and ensure consistency across systems and reporting tools. Data Cleaning & Data Quality Identify incomplete, duplicated, inconsistent, or inaccurate records. Build and maintain exception lists for data requiring correction or approval. Support structured data-cleaning activities and maintain an appropriate audit trail. Monitor data-quality indicators and follow up on unresolved issues. Ensure changes to critical inventory or master-data fields are properly controlled and documented. Analysis & Reporting Prepare inventory-control reports and management summaries. Analyze consumption, stock levels, inventory movements, and stock-variance trends. Use Excel and other available tools to perform reconciliation, exception analysis, and operational reporting. Highlight operational risks including unusual consumption, insufficient stock, data inconsistencies, and unresolved variances. Support data-driven supply planning and inventory decisions. Process & Digital Workflow Improvement Participate in improving inventory-control and master-data procedures. Translate operational requirements into structured workflows, dashboards, alerts, and system controls. Participate in testing or developing requirements for digital tools such as: Inventory-control workbenches Data-review screens Dashboards Web applications Automated exception reports Ability to understand front-end workflow logic, required fields, validations, alerts, user roles, and approval steps is considered a strong advantage. Programming experience is not mandatory; however, candidates who can understand or contribute to digital workflow and Web App design will have an advantage. Qualifications Minimum 1 year of relevant experience in Inventory, Procurement, Accounting, Materials Management, or Stock Control within a hospital environment . Experience with medical supplies or hospital inventory is strongly preferred. Strong understanding of inventory reconciliation and stock-control principles. Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy. Experience in Master Data, Item Master, or data-governance activities is highly preferred. Good analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to investigate discrepancies rather than simply adjusting system balances. Strong communication skills and ability to coordinate with Supply Chain, Finance, Clinical Departments, Pharmacy, and other stakeholders. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced hospital environment. Excel & Systems Skills Candidates should have practical working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including areas such as: XLOOKUP / VLOOKUP SUMIFS Pivot Tables Filters and data validation Duplicate detection Data reconciliation Basic data analysis and reporting Experience with ERP, WMS, inventory-management systems, Google Sheets, dashboards, or similar digital platforms is an advantage. Preferred Educational Background Bachelor’s degree in one of the following or a related field is preferred: Supply Chain Management Business Administration Accounting Management Information Systems Information Systems Logistics Data Management Relevant professional certifications in Supply Chain, Inventory Management, Data Analytics, or Data Governance are considered an advantage. Key Competencies The ideal candidate should demonstrate: High Data Accuracy Analytical Thinking Problem Solving Root Cause Analysis Data Cleaning Inventory Reconciliation Master Data Governance Documentation Discipline Process Improvement Ownership and Accountability Ability to learn and adapt to digital systems What We Are Looking For We are not looking only for someone who can enter inventory data . We are looking for someone who can: question the data, detect errors, investigate discrepancies, organize information, improve controls, and help build a more reliable digital inventory-management environment. Experience with medical Supplies & Healthcare Awareness is Preferred .

The role demands a strategic thinker with strong communication skills, technical knowledge of industrial services, and a proven ability to close deals and drive revenue growth. Promote Industrial services such as third-party inspection, NDE, QA/QC, Pressure Vessel inspection services. Develop and implement sales strategies to achieve and exceed revenue targets. Collaborate with the technical team to ensure services are delivered as per client expectations. Support the development and execution of marketing campaigns, both digital and offline. review_candidates.title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer - Tech Lead
review_candidates.description: About OpenMined OpenMined is a 501(c)(3) non-profit foundation that brings together leading minds in AI, security, and privacy technology to develop open-source solutions that transform how data can be accessed and shared. Founded in 2017, we've grown into a global community of over 18,000 members working to ensure that privacy protection and AI innovation reinforce each other rather than undermine one another. We are driven by a simple challenge: the most valuable data for solving humanity's greatest challenges remains locked away due to privacy concerns, and we can change that through technology rather than compromise. About The Role We're looking for a Senior / Staff Software Engineer to join OpenMined , a nonprofit building open-source infrastructure for federated AI. You'll lead our 😱 ScreamingFace squad, the team that makes this vision real by building the internet's first leaderboard for fusion models (ensembles) and the open toolkit supporting benchmark evaluations for fusion models. Today, claims that the newest solo LLM beats the others are everywhere, and almost none of them can be checked or compared with the performance achieved by combining LLMs into more powerful fusion models. Results are self-reported, expensive to rerun, and hard to pick apart. We think there's a better standard: every fusion and benchmark run compiles to a single line of text that anyone can replay for almost nothing, and a score counts only once someone else can reproduce it. The ScreamingFace toolkit is the open-source Python library and engine, leveraging our URL4 protocol, to let any researcher (a frontier lab, a university group, an independent builder) compose ensembles and routers across open and closed models, using their own keys, and grade them against pinned benchmarks. The ScreamingFace leaderboard is the public map of the quality-cost frontier, backed by a shared cache that makes every result on it cheap to verify and easy to build on. This is a hands-on technical leadership role . You understand the long term vision. You write code. You make architecture decisions. You set engineering standards by example.
